name: visa_check_finances
description: Review bank statement financial evidence for a Schengen visa. Calculates the minimum required balance (€65/day × days × applicants), compares against provided savings, and returns PASS/HOLD/FAIL with the required and provided amounts. Also flags common red flags: large recent deposits, thin margins, accounts opened less than 6 months ago, and sponsored vs self-funded cases.

applicant_count.description: Number of applicants the bank statement must cover

duration_days.description: Duration of the trip in days

monthly_income.description: Monthly net income (in the currency specified by the currency field)

savings_balance.description: Current savings / available balance shown on the bank statement

currency.description: Currency of the amounts provided (e.g. GBP, EUR, USD)

funding_source.description: How the trip is funded: self-funded, employer-funded, or third-party sponsor
